snippet.title: Trapformer - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Prepare to rage on October 20 in Trapformer.

Trapformer is the ultimate test in a punishing platformer adventure! Prepare to navigate through 20 dangerous levels filled with hidden traps that will to test your sanity.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2912730/Trapformer/
Website: https://lairitongames.com/

Music by Hansen Trackz
